_: M7's story on the continent of Aethermoor (proposal, November 20). at: atlas pixels on Chris's nine-region atlas (4608 x 3072, north up; the 3D continent uses the same). body: a finished 3D place that can be this place (borrowed), or null (to build). change: what differs from M7.

places.name: Hearthstone Keep
places.body: the castle on the central island (on the 3D continent; its halls to build)
places.beat: The eternal hearth gutters mid-Council and the torches go blue. Fenwick opens the reliquary: Hearthbrand, the Stillwater Lance, Cairnmaul. Tamsin takes the one that beats yours. Sneck the Tallyman bolts with the Warden's Seal. The Keep is the hub all game: the Great Hall, the war room's Ladder, the galleries of claimed relics.
places.change: The Keep stands on its island in the inner sea, so its four gates become four crossings: a boat west (the Hearth Road), a bridge north (the Old Bridge), a crossing east (the Sunward Road) and the causeway south (the Blackwater Causeway). M7 already gives the Keep exactly these four roads out.

places.name: The Hearth Road
places.body: Coven's jetty (where the boat lands) and Envoi's Ember Line road (an old road with a humped bridge)
places.beat: Bandits and Tallymen on the road, the first road gates held by their guards, the Milestone Fire (the first Hearthfire). M2's whole Gauntlet road lives here.
places.change: M7's 'Hearth Road North' runs west on this map: the Keep's boat to the landing, then the road through the woods to Thornhollow.

places.name: Thornhollow
places.body: Coven's Wickhollow (built, in the 3D world now)
places.beat: Pip joins. Captain Dael's bounty board, Nell's store, Hilda's forge (tempering), the Thornwatch lodge. The hub of Act I.
places.change: Wickhollow's 3D town under Thornhollow's name. Its palisade ring would be added; its forge was already a smith's.

places.name: The Thornway and Briarmaw's Den
places.body: Coven's Thornwood (a wood inside a thorn hedge; built)
places.beat: Old Snag the boar with the ranger's hatchet in his hide, the thorn walls the Thornsplitter cuts. At the heart of the thorns, Briarmaw: the first Brand (the Brand of Briars), and the crownwalls fall.
places.change: The Thornway lies south-east of the town here, not north.

places.name: Fawnrest Shrine
places.body: Coven's cottage in its glade (built; the shrine to add)
places.beat: The white deer have fled. Sister Alondra dreams of four Sleepers. The Rot-Stag, once the white stag of Fawnrest; the Gloamwing with the Fawnrest bell in its silk.
places.change: Close south of Thornhollow instead of north-east. Its old road on to the Highfold is gone (the mountains are across the sea here).

places.name: Mossfall and Mosswatch Tower
places.beat: Old Garret's midnight lights at Mosswatch turn out to be Tallyman signals. Mossfall, the fen village, is where the fen stair later leads down into the Gloomfen.
places.change: West of Thornhollow toward the coast, as in M7.

places.name: The Hindwood
places.body: Envoi's forest road to Dawnroost (a mossy flagstone road through the forest; built in Envoi)
places.beat: The deep woods between Thornhollow and Eldergrove: deer, thornhounds, the long way round.
places.change: North of Thornhollow, leading on to Eldergrove.

places.name: Eldergrove and the Heartroot
places.body: Envoi's Eldergrove's edge (a giant elder with a dark hollow between its roots; built in Envoi)
places.beat: In the Eldergrove Heartroot, the Rotwarden wears a smith-forged mask that turns the eldest trees' sap to ichor. The second Brand (the Brand of the Heartroot). Act I ends; the second council sits.
places.change: Envoi's own Eldergrove place, even its name, moved south into the western forest's heart. The Heartroot is the hollow between the elder's roots.

places.name: The Blackwater Causeway
places.beat: The long causeway from the Keep's south gate across the inner sea to the fen: the first way into the Gloomfen.
places.change: A true causeway across open water on this map.

places.name: The Murkway
places.beat: The fen road down from Mossfall: the second way in, by Willowmurk's safe paths. Mire leeches in the fords.
places.change: Runs south from the Wilds into the wetlands, as in M7.

places.name: Willowmurk
places.beat: The willow village whose wards went dark; the willow-wights walk. Grandfather Willow.
places.change: Chris's atlas names this region 'Southern Wetlands: Bogmire and Willowmurk', so it was painted for these two places.

places.name: Rotbridge
places.beat: Hodge's toll-bar across the channel. Tamsin falls to the Unsmith here, and trades his starter for a corrupted relic.
places.change: It also guards the road from the Thornway to Bogmire, so the Gloomfen stays shut until the third council, as in M7.

places.name: Bogmire
places.body: Coven's Bogmire (the stilt town; built, same name)
places.beat: The Lantern Mother is taking Bogmire's children.
places.change: Named Mossfall in the 3D world for now; it should go back to Bogmire.

places.name: The Lanternfen and the fen’s dark heart
places.beat: The Lantern Mother, last lamplighter of Misthollow, in her drowned grove: the seventh Brand (the Brand of Lanterns).
places.change: Coven's fen’s dark heart serves M7's Mother's Hollow, and it takes that lore name (Chris, November 24: "Use the lore name from Moon Faire and Envoi"): the Lantern Mother's drowned grove is the fen’s dark heart; the Lanternfen around it keeps its name.

places.name: The Long Boardwalk
places.beat: Miles of old boardwalk east across the marsh, planks missing.
places.change: The atlas paints these boardwalks.

places.name: The Misthollow Ruins and the Drowned Belfry
places.beat: The city that sank. The drowned choir sings under it; the Drowned Cantor.
places.change: The atlas paints 'flooded pale ruins' here. (Envoi has a mountain town called Misthollow; it becomes Peak's Veil, so the name stays M7's.)

places.name: The Blackwater Reach and the Tidal Flats
places.beat: The Blackwater Leviathan is sinking boats, chained by the Tallymen's collar: the eighth Brand (the Brand of the Deep). The salvage camps on the flats.
places.change: Where the fen meets the south coast.

places.name: The Old Bridge
places.body: Envoi's shipyard (a harbour castle at the end of a long bridge; built in Envoi)
places.beat: The way north out of the Keep, opened with the second council.
places.change: A long bridge from the Keep's island to the northern shore.

places.name: Drystone Lea and Plankford
places.body: Envoi's cold moor (a ruined drystone hut) and northern crossroads (built in Envoi)
places.beat: The lowland wilds on the way to the peaks: pass brigands, the Tallymen's ice-cutters.
places.change: On the cliff-top meadows of the north shore.

places.name: Shrinewood and Silverfall
places.beat: The shrine woods and the falls below the mountains.
places.change: Along the north shore toward the peaks.

places.name: The Last Camp
places.body: Envoi's frozen camp (built in Envoi; same spot)
places.beat: The last fire before the climb.
places.change: At the mountains' foot.

places.name: Frostmere and Beneath Frostmere
places.body: Envoi's Frostmere's shore (built in Envoi; same name)
places.beat: Hush beats under the frozen lake: the Rime-Abbot (Brother Aurel) and the sixth Brand (the Brand of Frost). The drowned monks of Frostmere.
places.change: Comes earlier on the road up than in M7 (there it was the far end, past Stormwatch). Order change: Chris's call.

places.name: The Rockslide Pass
places.body: Envoi's frozen pass (built in Envoi; same spot)
places.beat: The road up through the snow. Rime wolves, peak-trolls.
places.change: As in M7: between the camp and Peak's Veil.

places.name: Peak's Veil and the Highfold
places.body: Envoi's Misthollow (a town of pale towers high on the peaks) and the dead Moonwell above it (built in Envoi)
places.beat: The bell at Peak's Veil rings for a fallen monk. Mother Wynn opens the Highfold; the Drowned Abbess; the Thunder-Roc nests on the crags.
places.change: Envoi's pale mountain town becomes the monastery; the Moonwell above it becomes the Highfold.

places.name: Ironhold, the Iron Stair and Harrow's Forge
places.beat: The missing smith is Harrow Ironvein, Hilda's twin: he stole the Worldforge's plans, and Thane Brundar sealed the lower halls to hide it. Mother Anvil in the Deeps: the fifth Brand (the Brand of Iron).
places.change: Deep in the north-east peaks.

places.name: Stormwatch and the Frost Road
places.beat: Rook, a former Tallyman, lays out the plan. After the game, the Emberless Reach opens past Stormwatch.
places.change: On the north-east coast; the Frost Road runs back south-west to Frostmere.

places.name: The Sunward Road
places.beat: East out of the Keep after Act I: the caravan road, a wrecked caravan with forge loot.
places.change: A crossing east from the island to the desert shore.

places.name: Sandspire
places.beat: The desert town: Zara al-Khem's humming crate, Idris's gem shop, the Spire Hearth.
places.change: The atlas paints a town on the east shore here.

places.name: The Dust Trail, Dusthaven and the Deep Shaft
places.beat: Luma's secret sunstone heart. The Sand Wyrm under the Dust Trail. Kharzul the Glass Scorpion in the Deep Shaft, Cinderfang in his tail: the third Brand (the Brand of Glass).
places.change: South through the canyons.

places.name: The Glass Flats and Miragewell
places.beat: Dune-glass walls, mirages, the Wisp-Queen; the oasis of Miragewell far to the east.
places.change: East across the desert.

places.name: Scorchgate Ruins and the Vaults
places.beat: The Ashen Warden still guards a vault of ash: the fourth Brand (the Brand of Ash).
places.change: Toward the south-east canyon coast.

places.name: The Hearth Below
places.beat: The fifth council opens the four gifts. The Hollow Council fought back to back in the Hollow Hall; the Ash Stair, the Chained Deep (Tamsin rejoins), and the Worldforge: the Unsmith in three phases. Then Rekindle, Release or Kindle Anew.
places.change: Under the Keep's island, as in M7.
